newsitem.title: GREECE: EXPLOSION DAMAGES GREEK COST GUARD FUEL STATION.
newsitem.headline: EXPLOSION DAMAGES GREEK COST GUARD FUEL STATION.

text.p: A bomb explosion damaged on Monday a Greek coast guard feul station in this port city near Athens but no one was hurt, police said.
They said the makeshift device, complete with dynamite and a detonator, was placed next to a pump on the grounds of the Greek coast guard.
Several pumps were damaged but the fuel tanks did not explode, they added.
Special anti-terrorist police who examined the site indicated that the attack was unlikely the work of one of Greece's urban guerrilla groups.
There was no claim of responsibility for the bombing.
